blocks.text: The reality of your daily data workflow

Your day as a digital marketing analyst involves more than just staring at a marketing performance dashboard. You spend most of your time gathering data, cleaning spreadsheets, and communicating results to stakeholders. Every time you switch from Chrome to Slack or Excel, you lose focus. This fragmentation is the primary cause of digital debt.
How to manage your marketing performance dashboard faster

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It helps you keep your flow by answering questions while you look at your screen. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about a specific chart or data point. Lazur reads your screen and gives you an answer out loud. You stay in the zone.
Hold ⌥ ⌘ when you are stuck on a complex formula in your marketing performance dashboard. Ask Lazur to explain the logic of your current cell. It will break down the formula step by step.
blocks.title: Use Lazur for formula help

blocks.text: Reporting takes up too much time. Instead of typing out every update, use the dictation feature. Hold fn to start dictating into your email client or reporting tool. It provides clean, formatted text that matches your professional tone. You can use it for quick Slack updates or longer performance summaries.

When you need to research new trends or competitor moves, let Lazur handle the heavy lifting. You can ask it to perform research in the background. It opens its own Chrome tabs, compiles the data, and gives you a summary. This saves you from having dozens of tabs open, which slows down your Mac.

blocks.text: When to use Lazur in your workflow

Use Lazur when you find yourself repeating the same actions. If you are constantly looking for a button in a complex interface, ask where it is. Lazur will draw a circle around it. If you need to write a standard weekly report, use dictation to get the draft done fast.

You handle sensitive client data. Lazur only listens and looks at your screen while you hold the shortcut keys. It does not store your screen images or audio. None of your content is used to train AI models. Always check your employer rules regarding data privacy before using any AI tool on company devices.

faq.question: Can Lazur build my marketing performance dashboard for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons, edit files, or operate other apps for you. It helps you by explaining, guiding, and dictating, so you can build your dashboard faster.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my browser-based analytics tools?
faq.answer: Yes. Since Lazur sees your screen, it works with any web-based dashboard, including Google Analytics, SEMrush, or Ahrefs.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe for my client data?
faq.answer: Lazur does not store your screen content or audio. It is a tool for your Mac, and it does not train its models on your private data. Always follow your company's data handling policies.
